purpose: Run the five registered Basic BDQ policy seeds from fresh state through the first hard target synchronization and preserve complete, reviewable training lineage. This is a bounded training-artifact integrity gate, not held-out evaluation or effectiveness evidence.

transport.transition_completion: complete the pending action when the same agent next appears in DecisionSteps or TerminalSteps

runtime_mutated_files.reason: The ML-Agents Unity timer writer updates this run-owned profiling sidecar during execution.

campaign.seed_mapping_rule: Use this explicit table exactly. Never derive a seed from a run name, hash, process identifier, or clock.
campaign.exploration_mapping_rule: Reset one CPU torch.Generator seeded with 61001 at the start of each independent policy run; the registered exploration seed is intentionally reused and is not derived.
campaign.training_scenario_coverage: Each run uses scenario seed 31001 for every Basic episode; episode target placement follows the unchanged basic contract hash over the zero-based episode index.
campaign.held_out_evaluation_seeds: No held-out evaluation data are generated by R3T; any evaluation seed list requires a separate registration.

collection.clean_stop: Complete transition 49996, finish optimizer update 10000 and its target synchronization, then stop before selecting or applying another live action.

training_horizon.boundary_rule: The final completed transition and final optimizer update are both recorded; no post-boundary live action is selected.
training_horizon.registration_rationale: R3T is an artifact-lineage gate. The horizon ends at the first existing hard target-synchronization boundary so the shared bounded gate can prove a clean synchronized checkpoint without introducing an unregistered second synchronization or an unrestricted runner.

contents: online and target network state dictionaries
lossless replay rows, frames, accounting, cursor, and sampling RNG state
scheduled selector RNG state and epsilon schedule
runtime, package, optimizer settings, and policy/exploration seed identity
versioned checkpoint contract hash and canonical state hash

selection.rule: Select the checkpoint saved at optimizer update 10000, the predeclared clean training boundary; do not inspect return, success, loss, Q-values, or any other outcome for selection.

learning_curve.return_definition: Mean observed episode-prefix return at the sampled update: completed target_hit/decision_limit episode returns plus the current active episode prefix when one exists; denominator is observed_episode_count, so every sample remains finite before the first reset.
learning_curve.success_definition: Target-hit terminal episodes divided by observed_episode_count; an active incomplete episode contributes zero until it reaches target_hit, and the denominator is recorded explicitly.
learning_curve.q_value_summary_definition: For the sampled replay batch used by the update, record finite mean, minimum, and maximum per branch for current online Q, online next-state Q, and target next-state Q before the optimizer step.
learning_curve.timing_definition: Record wall-clock seconds spent completing the transition and optimizer operation for the sampled update. Timing is diagnostic and volatile; it is excluded from canonical result equality.

stop_only_at: clean checkpoint boundary before the next live action
invalid_run_criteria: runtime, package, source, player, or configuration identity drift
wrong decision, transition, optimizer-update, or target-synchronization count
duplicate, discarded, partial, or unaccounted transition or update
pending decision at a registered checkpoint or final boundary
missing, corrupt, or mismatched checkpoint, replay, RNG, or hash state
nonfinite learning-curve metric or missing denominator
missing provenance, artifact, rejection, or command record
unexpected live process after worker completion
stopping.failure_policy: Write a rejected attempt under the campaign artifact root and retain existing output; never convert an incomplete or failed seed into an accepted result and never overwrite an earlier attempt.

tracked_artifacts: curated summary and checksums only after accepted runs
canonical_equality_excludes: serialized trace and metrics artifact bytes and hashes in campaign metadata

process_leak_audit.method: Compare tasklist PIDs for the copied Unity executable before and after each worker; UnityEnvironment.close must leave no new matching process.

exclusions: Basic effectiveness thresholds or random-policy improvement
success-rate, convergence, generalization, or sample-efficiency claims
final policy selection based on outcomes
strategic combat, research reflex, or LLM director
ONNX export or live Unity handoff
unregistered duration, stopping, or checkpoint-selection choices
